Bug_Details:
Log tag too long, cannot exceed 23 characters. Log.isLoggable(tag, level) throws an IllegalArgumentException if its tag
argument is more than 23 characters long.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the logger.isLoggable method is incorrectly called with a string tag instead of a Level. This will throw an IllegalArgumentException if the tag exceeds 23 characters, which is the intended behavior.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method of the LogTagLengthBug class, which uses a tag longer than 23 characters. This triggers the bug because the logger.isLoggable method is incorrectly called with a Level instead of the tag, causing an IllegalArgumentException if the tag length exceeds 23 characters.
